title: YOU'RE NOT AN ALPHA
summary: NH dissects the alpha/beta/sigma/Chad meme culture: its 4chan joke origins, why it grips young men in a male identity crisis, and why the 'alpha wolf debunked' narrative is dishonest. He concludes the archetypes are astrology for men, that hierarchies are real but fluid, and that you become a man first and the rewards follow.
claims: The alpha, sigma and Chad archetypes started on 4chan as jokes; the sigma male was invented to mock the alpha meme
NH says he was among those who started the virgin vs Chad memes on 4chan and made some originals still in circulation
Men obsess over hierarchy memes because status is central to male self-identification and access to women; women judge status in the opposite sex for mate selection
Sigma males and MGTOW still define themselves around women; MGTOW is the most female-obsessed group of men he has seen
NoFap is marketed as self-improvement but its goal is still to score a girl
Male identity is in crisis: manhood used to mean being tough, providing and protecting; with guidelines gone, memes fill the void
Hypermasculine caricatures like GigaChad are produced by men devoid of masculinity; Greek statues showed natural physiques as the pinnacle instead
Young men growing up without real fathers or role models adopted internet memes as role models
Schenkel did not debunk the alpha wolf, he refined it: pack hierarchies are flexible and the alpha pair holds reproductive privilege; lions and gorillas clearly have alphas
Those most eager to deny social hierarchies sit at the bottom of them; you cannot both deny the pyramid and claim to be oppressed by it
You can only change your standing in a hierarchy once you recognize that it exists
The meme alpha's tenets (big dick, money, bullying, sleeping around) teach terrible lessons, and GigaChad memes are mostly posted by its opposite
Extreme hedonism (alpha culture) and extreme asceticism (NoFap) both fail as answers to an extreme crisis
An alpha is a leader of the group; researchers found the longest-lasting alpha chimps are the kindest, not the most violent
Masculine married men he knows never talk about alpha or beta; these things are unspoken
The alpha/sigma typology is astrology for men without a defined identity
Modern masculinity glorifies self-destruction and dying young; raising many kids and building an empire is far manlier
Men chase resources to attract women, so the sigma grindset of rejecting women to hoard money is pointless and perfect for capitalists and consumerism
Blind productivity does not make anyone happy; NH, who works in AI, says sigma males behave like robots
You are not born alpha or beta; hierarchies are social and mobile, and a true alpha would sacrifice his position if it bettered the group
You cannot reverse-engineer manhood: you become a man and then you get women, not the other way around
